experiment.title: Account for weights and saved allocations
experiment.implementation: Saved-header/log accounting tool is ready. Mapped spans are kept separate from estimated components; 8K allocation measurements remain held.
experiment.only_change: Read saved GGUF header inventory and historical logs; allocate no model memory.
experiment.hypothesis: Explicit accounting helps distinguish disk capacity from physical RAM needs.
prerequisites: Explicit testing go-ahead for any --run command
Offline validation receipt matches current sources
Quiet host; leave unrelated VM/build work alone
proof: Target and helper file bytes separate from lazy lookup mapping
Repeated reservations counted once per role/backend/type
Unknown resident pages, driver/QSA/scratch and background footprint stated
stop_if: Unexpected quality failure or new swap
experiment.limits: Component sums are estimates, not measured RSS/peak RAM or proof that 8K fits.

comparison.adoption_gate: At least 5 percent median complete-task improvement on the chosen workload, or useful capacity gain with an explicitly accepted speed tradeoff; no unexplained quality failure or new swap. Report control drift and all raw passes.
comparison.percentage_rules: TPS gain = 100*(candidate/control-1). Time reduction = 100*(1-candidate/control). Requires finite positive matched metrics. Do not add percentages from separate experiments.
